correctness.rationale: Proof gives every symmetric multiplicity, the q>=2 one-quantum-lower unused capacity for all N>=3, orthogonal isometry extension, exact compressed-energy identity and all-state trace equality. Equality states show coefficient-one sharpness. At N=2 optimal two-thirds follows by sum of two largest eigenvalues of the S2 block; symmetric maximally mixed state saturates and a 3-to-2 rank obstruction forbids any state-independent positive coefficient. Standalone local replay checks matrix identities, random mixed states, exact equality examples and a passive-dephasing counterexample. No finite test is invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two-or-more-excitation weight is a natural coarse experimentally motivated observable, and the result gives a complete sharp finite-cell work guarantee, a single reusable discharge unitary for all N>=3 symmetric mixed states, and the exact N=2 resource obstruction. A three-cell state with passive dephasing nonetheless has guaranteed positive global work, demonstrating that the witness captures structural coherence/symmetry beyond the generic incoherent-ergotropy lower bound. The conclusion is useful even without a charging dynamics theorem.
